population: all 917 catalysts / 89,074 lab rows; no model, no seeds, no estimator

name_format.rule: 0b. Name == M1-M2-M3-Support on every row, and M1/M2/M3/Support constant within each Name

fingerprint_join.rule: 0. fingerprint = sorted multiset of exact (temperature, yield) pairs per catalyst; unique within each file; 1:1 match for every catalyst

support_is_dominant_element.rule: 1. element parsed from Support (e.g. La2O3 -> La) has the strictly largest loading (unique maximum)

promoters_present.rule: 2. every non-'none' promoter in M1/M2/M3 has loading > 0

loadings_rule.rule: 3. each non-'none' promoter slot adds 10/3 wt%, the support element adds 90 wt% (merged if same element), rescaled to sum to 100; all 65 loadings within 1e-6

reported_not_gated.note_rescaling: With 3 promoters the raw sum is already 100, so only catalysts with 1 or 2 promoters test the rescale step.
reported_not_gated.note_rule_only_map: Built from Name and loadings alone, with no yields; an independent check on the fingerprint join.

row_key_collisions.definition: 5. Count rows whose exact (Temperature, C2y) key is shared with at least one other row, minus the number of such keys. Equivalently: rows that are not the first occurrence of their key. This is the "607 collisions" figure (672 rows in 65 shared keys; 672 - 65 = 607); it is why rows cannot be matched one by one between the two files. Most of it is zero yields: 551 of the 672 rows have C2y exactly 0, in 5 keys (one per temperature). Non-zero yields alone give 60 keys / 121 rows / 61 collisions.

loader_codes_match_data_load.rule: 4. load_with_conditions() runs (re-asserts the multiset match); same n_cat as Data.load(); each composition key gets the same code from both loaders; rows sorted by (code, temperature, yield) are identical arrays

reported_not_gated.note: The two loaders list rows in different orders, so groups from load_with_conditions() must not be used with row-ordered arrays from Data.load(). Codes agree per catalyst, not per row position.

key_order: taken from the map in git HEAD (same 917 names)
map_write_note: skipped: rebuilt bytes identical to the file on disk
